summary.text: David Rochefort is a Republican state senator who has represented New Hampshire Senate District 1 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pharmacist and business owner, he previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: David Rochefort was born in Lancaster, New Hampshire, lives in Littleton, and earned a B.S. in pharmacy from the University of Rhode Island in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a pharmacist and owning a specialty pharmacy.
He volunteered on the Littleton Zoning Board of Adjustment and was appointed to the New Hampshire Board of Pharmacy by Governor Chris Sununu (R), where he served in roles including vice president.
Rochefort represented Grafton 1 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2022 to 2024.
He succeeded Carrie Gendreau (R) in the Senate, assumed office on December 4, 2024, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
